pure-announcement.rationale: It is an operational how-to guide for an existing API feature, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No supplied nearest concept (code mode, evals, session capture) covers prompt caching or prefix-oriented prompt structuring.

unfalsifiable.rationale: It is primary vendor documentation whose described behaviours (cached_tokens, cache_write_tokens, breakpoints, TTL) are directly observable through the API.

durability.rationale: It is dominated by vendor- and generation-specific mechanics — GPT-5.6-vs-earlier behaviour matrices, 0.1x read and 1.25x write pricing, per-model retention lists, 1,024-token minimums and 15-rpm key limits — that OpenAI can and does change; the stable-prefix-first principle is the small durable kernel.

actionability.rationale: Its steps are product-only parameters (prompt_cache_key, prompt_cache_breakpoint, prompt_cache_options.ttl) rather than provider-independent guidance, though the static-content-first ordering advice transfers.

atomicity.rationale: Everything covers the single idea of exact-prefix prompt caching — structure, breakpoints, measurement, pricing — stateable in one paragraph.
